article_framing_rejections.headline: Father arrested in Virginia in connection with Fort Pierce infant malnutrition death

lead_independence.headline: Father arrested in Virginia in connection with Fort Pierce infant malnutrition death
lead_independence.lead: The St. Lucie County Sheriff's Office announced Tuesday that Jason Gunter, the biological father of a 3-month-old who died from severe dehydration and malnutrition, was taken into custody by the United States Marshals Service at his home in Mechanicsville, Virginia. Detectives had obtained an arrest warrant for Gunter in connection with the ongoing investigation into the child's death. He has been charged with felony child neglect causing great harm and is awaiting extradition to St. Lucie County.
